settings.custom_liquid: {%- if template.name == 'index' and request.design_mode == false -%}<script>window.location.replace('/products/discovery-deck' + window.location.search);</script>{%- endif -%}<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans:ital,wdth,wght@0,75..100,300..700;1,75..100,300..700&display=swap">{{ 'mezcalomano.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}<style>img.header__heading-logo{content:url('https://mezcalomano.com/assets/brand/logos/mezcalomano_lockup_stacked_dark.svg');object-fit:contain}</style><style>.mm-qa{color:#B86744;font-weight:600}@media (max-width:600px){.announcement-bar__message{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;letter-spacing:.04em}.announcement-bar__message span::before{font-size:1.15rem}.announcement-bar__message svg{flex:none}}</style><script>document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){document.querySelectorAll('.product__description p').forEach(function(p){var w=document.createTreeWalker(p,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);var n=w.nextNode();while(n&&!n.nodeValue.trim())n=w.nextNode();if(!n)return;var m=n.nodeValue.match(/^(\s*)(Q:|A:)/);if(!m)return;var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='mm-qa';s.textContent=m[2];n.nodeValue=n.nodeValue.slice(m[0].length);n.parentNode.insertBefore(s,n);n.parentNode.insertBefore(document.createTextNode(' '),n);n.nodeValue=n.nodeValue.replace(/^\s+/,'');});});</script>
